units.title: Chalets & Cabines
units.allowMultipleLoginsHint: When off (default), only one device can stay signed in with an owner phone for this unit. A new login signs out the previous device.

config.title: Resort Configuration
config.subtitle: Season, invite limits, and weekend days for {{name}}.
config.allowCabineHint: When off, cabine owners and tenants cannot create guest invitations for this resort.
config.cabineLimitInvitesHint: When off, cabines can invite unlimited guests. When on, weekday/weekend limits apply.
config.cabineUnlimitedNote: Cabines have unlimited invitations (no weekday/weekend cap).
config.cabinePaidHint: Cabine invitations always scan at reception then gate. When enabled, reception must confirm payment before gate entry.
config.chaletDoubleScanHint: When on, chalet guests scan at reception then at the gate. When off, one scan at either checkpoint validates the invitation.
config.marketplaceEnabledHint: When on, owners and guests can browse sale/rental listings in the resort app, and staff can manage them here. When off, both tabs are hidden.
config.seasonHint: Set your resort season dates and how invitation allowances renew during that period.
config.periodAllowanceMonthlyHint: Limits reset each month while the season is active.
config.periodAllowanceEntireHint: One pool of invitations for the entire season.
config.seasonDatesRequired: Season start and end dates are required.
config.seasonEndBeforeStart: Season end must be on or after the start date.
config.chaletDefaultsHint: New chalets use these weekday and weekend limits each month. Use Units to grant one-off bonuses.
config.ownerTenantToggle: Separate owner vs tenant chalet limits
config.ownerTenantHint: When on, hand-over prefills use owner or tenant defaults based on active tenancy today. Cabines are unchanged.
config.invalidChaletLimits: Chalet weekday and weekend limits must be zero or higher.
config.invalidDailyCap: Daily cap must be greater than zero, or leave blank for unlimited.
config.invalidAdvanceDays: Max advance days must be zero or higher, or leave blank for unlimited.
config.notAuthorized: You do not have permission to edit resort configuration.
config.dailyRulesHint: These apply to the whole resort. Leave a field empty for no limit.
config.dailyInvitationCapHint: The most guest invitations the resort accepts for a single visit day, across all units.
config.maxAdvanceDaysHint: How many days ahead guests can be invited. 0 means today only.

guestPatterns.title: Unusual invite activity
guestPatterns.subtitle: Units whose invitations this month look different from normal use, for example many new guests or the same name used again and again.
guestPatterns.notAuthorized: You do not have permission to view this page.
guestPatterns.explainWhatBody: Each month we compare every unit's invitations against a few simple warning signs and list the units that match at least one.
guestPatterns.explainSafeBody: This page only informs you. Owners can keep inviting guests as usual unless you decide to pause a unit.
guestPatterns.explainActionBody: Open a unit to see why it was listed and who was invited. If something looks wrong, contact the owner or pause new invitations for a while.
guestPatterns.sortedHint: Units that need the most attention appear first.
guestPatterns.emptyCalmBody: Every unit's invitations look normal. Nothing needs your attention.
guestPatterns.emptyNoInvitesBody: Units will appear here once guests are invited.
guestPatterns.noSignals_one: {{count}} invitation this month, no warning signs.
guestPatterns.noSignals_other: {{count}} invitations this month, no warning signs.
guestPatterns.pauseHint: The unit cannot create new invitations until the end of the chosen date. Invitations already sent still work.

signals.distinct_guests: {{count}} different guests were invited this month. We list a unit from {{threshold}} different guests.
signals.new_name_ratio: {{pct}}% of visits were by guests this unit had never invited before.
signals.name_reuse: One guest name was used for {{count}} visits while very few other guests were invited. The same invitation may be shared by several people.
signals.cross_unit: {{count}} of these guests were also invited by other units this month.
signals.issue_to_arrival_gap: {{count}} guests arrived less than 30 minutes after their invitation was created.
signals.weekend_saturation: All {{count}} invitations were for weekend days.
signals.device_ping_pong: The owner or tenant account was signed in on a different phone {{count}} times this month.
